- It raises `ProjectError` for an empty list. It also raises `ProjectError` naming the student, in the form `no email: Ames, Bo`, when a student has no email.

The error type is the existing `ProjectError`, which keeps the change small. I did not touch `__init__.py`, the docs or `CHANGES.txt`, since you asked for the minimum.

import unittest

from rosterkit.models import Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.contacts import contact_rows


class ContactRowTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_rows_are_sorted_and_aligned(self):
        rows = contact_rows([
            Student("2", "Zed", "Al", "B", "al@x.org"),
            Student("1", "Ames", "Bo", "A", "bo@x.org")
        ])
        self.assertEqual(rows, [
            "Ames, Bo  A  bo@x.org",
            "Zed, Al   B  al@x.org"
        ])

    def test_missing_email_names_the_student(self):
        pupil = Student("1", "Ames", "Bo", "A")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ProjectError, "Ames"):
            contact_rows([pupil])

    def test_empty_list_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            contact_rows([])
